changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Text Summarization' as task is causal tree extraction, not text summarization. Removed duplicate model 'Japanese Swallow-13b' (same as Swallow-13b). Consolidated output descriptions to more concise format.
Consolidated metric names - 'F1 Score' and 'F1' refer to same metric, 'weighted F1' is same as 'Weighted Triplet F1'. Kept distinct metrics used in the paper.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was used in the paper - only human evaluation and automatic metrics.

guideline: 0-100 scoring based on amount of post-editing required
Emphasis on primary disease correctness and causal relationships
Focus on root nodes and shallow layers as more important
Modifier relations considered less important than parent_of causal relations

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated similar criteria and removed redundant items. Kept the core evaluation criteria mentioned in the human evaluation guidelines.
